_readme: Mechanical equipment for the rooms below ground: furnaces, boilers, water heaters, coal bins, canning stations and preserving shelves. See library/AUTHORING.md.

text.description: {A:condition} {body} {noun} ticking away behind the cellar hatch, its firebox door leaking a line of orange light and the floor around it dusted black.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a squat square {body.color} {body} body with riveted seams, a hinged firebox door on the bottom edge, the {flue.color} {flue} flue pipe rising from the back edge.

text.description: {A:condition} {shell} {noun} with rivets down every seam, its {gauge} water gauge trembling and a slow red breath from the firebox door below.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a round {shell.color} {shell} drum with riveted seams, a small {gauge.color} {gauge} gauge on the front face, pipes rising over the back edge, the firebox door at the bottom edge.

text.description: {A:condition} {noun} keeping the house in hot water, its {casing} lid on tight and the {pipe} pipes sweating as it cools.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a round tank filling the cell, a domed {casing.color} {casing} lid, the {pipe.color} {pipe} vent pipe at the back edge, a ring burner at the bottom edge.

text.description: {A:condition} {casing} {noun} humming in the utility corner, the blower spinning up with a smell of warm dust and the igniter's click.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a low boxy {casing.color} {casing} cabinet with louvered vents, a round burner port on the front face, the {vent.color} {vent} vent pipe running into the back edge.

text.description: {A:condition} {body} {noun} heaped with black lumps, a short shovel leaning into the corner it makes with the wall and kindling stacked beside it.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a square open-topped {body.color} {body} box with {rim} banding at the rim, black coal lumps inside, a shovel handle laid across one corner.

text.description: {A:condition} {noun} run along the wall, {top} boards under a big {kettle} kettle and racks of {jar} jars waiting to be filled, the air still sweet with steam.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun} two cells long: a {top.color} {top} bench run with a round {kettle.color} {kettle} kettle set in at one end, racks of empty {jar.color} {jar} jars along the front edge, a towel and tongs at the other end.

text.description: {A:condition} {frame} {noun} stacked with sealed {jar} jars in ranks, their lids pencilled with dates and the ones at the back gone dark.
text.physical: Top-down view of {A:noun}: a {frame.color} {frame} shelf edge along the bottom, close rows of {jar.color} {jar} jar lids edge to edge, back against the top edge.
